column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
_felix_cap_active returns 2 when felix_declared fails, whether it printed nothing or printed the capability
a capabilities link whose target is gone is not an absent file: _felix_cap_active returns 2 and the row is unknown
a capabilities pipe or directory is no list: _felix_cap_active returns 2 at once for each, neither waiting on the pipe nor reading either as absent
a capability lookup that answers neither 0 nor 1 makes the row unknown, and says the declared list could not be read
a count over a first grep that failed is not a count: done 0 over two rows is unknown when that grep printed nothing, not answered
a declared list that could not be read makes a row grounded on a declared capability unknown, not not-applicable
a declared list that names api but came back with a failure is not trusted: the row is unknown, not done
a declared list whose substitution ended before it answered, with status 0, makes _felix_cap_active return 2 and the row unknown
a names lookup that returns 1 naming nothing, or 3, makes the row unknown and says the names could not be read
a names lookup whose substitution ended with status 0 and no text makes the row unknown, not done
a partial answer whose rows could not be counted is unknown, not answered
a whole answer whose rows could not be counted is unknown, not answered
an answer whose rows could not be counted is not ingested: the record prints 0 and appends nothing to the log
and _felix_cap_active returns 2 there, and the row grounded on it is unknown, not not-applicable
and done 2 over three rows is unknown when that grep printed two of them and failed, not answered
and it says the capabilities this project declares could not be read
and it says the engine functions the check names could not be read
and it says the rows could not be counted
and so with pipefail off in the caller
and the names lookup is one substitution whose one pipe reads the names, with no here-document
and the receipt over it, every other row done, is indeterminate and not commissioned
and with its rows uncountable it is unknown
felix_declared over a file of only comments and blank lines prints nothing and returns 0: it was read, and holds none
felix_declared returns nonzero and prints nothing when its grep fails, as any user, and _felix_cap_active returns 2
the capability lookup is one substitution, with no pipe, no here-document and no felix_has_line
the lookup of the names returns 2 and names nothing when its grep fails, with pipefail on or off
when the names a check holds could not be read from it, the row is unknown, not done
with felix_has_line failing as an unwritable here-document makes it fail, a declared api is still active and its row done
